t: Forge Steel centre punch set contains essential tools for creating accurate indentations in various materials. The 5-piece manual punch set is ideal for engineers and fabricators requiring precise starting points before drilling or fastening, and for general workshop applications. Each centre punch is constructed from heat-treated carbon steel, ensuring robust durability and consistent performance when marking steel, aluminium, copper, brass, and wood. Includes 1.6, 2, 2.4, 3.6, and 4mm punches for versatile use.
b: Can be Used For for Steel, Aluminium, Copper & Wood
